license.assessment: CC BY 4.0 is explicitly designated by metadata. Full legal terms are not reproduced in fetched record JSON or README. License legal code was outside the three authorized fetch URLs and was not fetched; detailed reuse obligations are not audited here.

corpus_documentation.development: dev.zip and dev_binaural.zip are listed; specific development speaker allocation/count is not specified in the fetched README.
filename_example_documentation_inconsist: README states speaker IDs 1–24 but uses m25adu2.wav as example.
README describes the final vowel of m25adu2.wav as /iː/ despite u in filename; no silent correction assumed.
corpus_documentation.pronunciation_screening: README reports pilot listening tests to identify unusable tokens due to poor pronunciations or other problems; no per-file independently corrected identity table inspected.

manual_segmentation.metadata_description: 91 hand-segmented VCVs in HTK format; at least three items per consonant with identical first/second vowels, plus 19 randomly selected VCVs.
manual_segmentation.interpretation: Hand segmentation describes boundaries. Neither filename consonant labels nor matching MLF segment labels establish independently human-corrected phoneme identity.
